I think the main things going for Glock is light weight and the striker fired mechanism with automatic safeties. All that lore stuff is secondary and arises from the primary advantages. The CZ is a cold war era gun, heavily based on Hi-Power that came out in 1935. So, it is heavier and employs the DA/SA mechanism with external safety.

It could be argued that CZs are even more reliable because of the DA/SA design. If you have a failure to fire, the glock needs to be cycled by hand to reset the trigger whereas the CZ just requires a trigger pull.

You have to just give consideration to what you think is going to work well for you. Go to a pistol range and try out every handgun in the size range you're looking from reputable manufacturers. You will like one better than the others. Glocks are rock solid reliable, cz are also great guns. Sig also makes great guns.
